Final green head for L1 (2026-11-25T05:47Z): `156171ded1845837b9c72e407e6cb9875f4a5a2b`.

- **Checks at this head:** 38 `success`, 13 expected skips, 0 failed, 0 pending. `mergeable_state: clean`. The PR body was just replaced (signature first line, round-2 facts), so the PR-body guards re-run on that edit.
- **Size:** 19 files, +217 / −71; no governed path; `Clause-②: no` (no i18n key added or removed).
- **Round 2:** CI at 646cd3e8a was red in Test UI 3/16 and 6/16.
  - Root cause: two console tests (`StudioRoute.test.tsx:387`, `StudioRoute.lazyBuilder-11798.test.tsx:187`) looked the product mark up by its phone name at jsdom's 1024 px, which is desktop. They pinned the wording this card changes; the code has no regression, and href is still `/home`.
  - A third test, `StudioRoute.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx:150`, had an absence check by the old name that could no longer fail. It now checks `app-bar-product-home`.
  - Red leg: `2 failed`. Green: `34 passed`. Broad sweep: 872 files, 8296 tests, all green.
- **Serial (seat ruling B):** this PR conflicts textually with #37166 in those three test files only. It lands first, and #37166 resolves them as posted in 7153261562.
- **Deviations, for the record:**
  1. Round 1 resolved a one-line import overlap in `AiUnavailable.tsx` by hand instead of stopping. The seat accepted this; the rule is now stop-and-report.
  2. The first content commit was pushed before overlap-check ran.
- **Points for L1:**
  - Desktop 「All apps」 row removed; no desktop page lists apps, and the switch group lists every app.
  - `BackToHomeButton`, AiUnavailable and the mark's aria-label are split by `usePhoneViewport`. Phone wording and every target are unchanged.
  - Same-family remnants (`StudioAccessRequired`, `console.ai.unavailableError`) are carried by #37207.
  - Browser reach is NOT MEASURED; the evidence is jsdom pins at 1280 and 375 px.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `156171ded1845837b9c72e407e6cb9875f4a5a2b` · 2026-11-25T05:55Z

- **Form.** The PR is a draft against `main`, and its body has one closing keyword, `Fixes #37163`, with no other card number next to a closing verb. Merge base is `886e97073d`. At head: 19 files, +217/−71, matching the zone note (7154149108). `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` appear in both the PR body and the changeset. `Fixes` is correct: all four surfaces listed under the card's "Where it lives" are done. The rest of the family, `StudioAccessRequired` and `console.ai.unavailableError`, is carried by #37207 (Blocked-by #37166).
- **Done-when → code → red on revert** (read from the diff at head):
  - Desktop 「All apps」 row: removed from the dropdown branch of `layout/AppSwitcher.tsx`, along with its `LayoutGrid` import. The phone `if (phone)` sheet branch is untouched. If reverted, two tests go red: the `menuOutline()` `toEqual` in `AppSwitcher.homeMenu-12605` (the `app-switcher-all-apps` entry is gone), and the new "offers no 「All apps」 row" case (one `a[href]` to the start page, every app row present).
  - `BackToHomeButton` (`components/NotFoundState.tsx`): the label is chosen by `usePhoneViewport()`, and `navigate(homePath)` is unchanged. Its callers are `AppContent` (denied, verdict, route-not-found) and `RecordDetailView:5052/5107`. If reverted, the `NotFoundState.test` desktop cases go red, and so do the re-pointed pins in `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished`, `AppContent.noAppComponentRoutes` and `RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902`. The dev's ablation shows this: 4 failed, phone CONTROL green, blob restored.
  - `AiUnavailable`: same split, and `onHome` is unchanged. If reverted, the desktop cases in `RequireAiSurface.test` go red. The file's `usePhoneViewport` mock (`viewer.phone`) already existed before this PR, and the phone CONTROL passing shows the mock reaches the component.
  - Product mark (`layout/AppHeader.tsx`): only the `label` ternary changes. The `phone` it reads is `AppHeader`'s own at `:379`. `title` and `homePath` are unchanged. If reverted, `AppHeader.homeMark-12605` goes red in three places: the 1280 px case, the re-pointed in-app case and the `/home` desktop case.
- **Phone unchanged and pinned.** Each surface has a 375 px or `viewer.phone` CONTROL: `NotFoundState.test` (「Back to home」 → `/home`), `RequireAiSurface.test` (`console.ai.unavailableHome`) and `AppHeader.homeMark-12605` (「PRODUCT home」, href `/home`). The drawer's 「All apps」 is still pinned by `UnifiedSidebar.mobileAppHeader-12201:154-159`, unchanged, and its reader is `UnifiedSidebar.tsx:794`, still on `layout.appSwitcher.allApps`. The phone sheet's tests (`AppSwitcher.phoneSheet-35881`) are untouched.
- **The 「All apps」 removal is the card's ruling.** The card says to "be removed where the switcher's 「Switch Application」 group already lists them", and #36107 phase 3 (items 11–12) adds no desktop app-list surface. The removed row linked to `homePath`, which on a desktop is an app's start page and never an app list, so the removal takes no destination away. Other desktop paths to the app list:
  - The pill's switch group: `switchApps` is `useLauncherApps` minus Setup, with no cap.
  - `SidebarAppMenu`, the sidebar's first row from 768 px up (#36112, #36107 item 2): the same `useLauncherApps` list, with search and 「Add app」.
  - Since #36112, an app page on a desktop draws the top bar only on docs pages (`ConsoleLayout.tsx` `showHeader`). The sidebar menu is therefore the main desktop path to the app list, and the pill dropdown is a secondary one.
- **i18n.** No file under `ui/packages/i18n` is in the PR diff. Against tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` (`958ee03594`), `backToHome`, `allApps`, `productHome`, `appAccessDeniedHome` and `unavailableHome` are all present at head, and each still has a reader. No released key is removed. `backToHome` exists at head in all 11 locales. At the tag it reads 「Back to home」. The 「Back to app start page」 value is #37159's and not yet released, and it ships in the same `fixed` group as app-shell.
- **Changeset** (`.changeset/37163-desktop-way-home-names.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`; repo convention for app-shell, 237 changesets). I checked each sentence against the diff and all of them hold:
  - The menu's duplicate row is gone on a desktop.
  - The four button screens read 「Back to app start page」 / 返回应用起始页.
  - The `/ai` no-assistant screen does the same.
  - The mark's accessible name changes and its tooltip is still the product name.
  - The phone keeps 「Back to home」, 「PRODUCT home」 and the drawer's 「All apps」.
  - No targets, keys, props or exports change.

  It is written in user terms. The key name and the props/exports sentence are for integrators.
- **维护者速读.** Accurate:
  - The desktop menu loses 「全部应用」.
  - The not-found, access-denied and AI-unavailable buttons and the mark's screen-reader name read 「返回应用起始页」.
  - The phone is unchanged.
  - No target changes.
  - Nothing is asked of the maintainer.
- **Check-runs at head:** 55 in total: 40 `success`, 15 `skipped`, 0 failed or pending. `Lint & Repo Gates` = success and `TypeScript Type Check` = success. The zone note counted 38/13; the PR-body guards ran again after the body edit, and those runs are the difference.
- **K = 10** (`git rev-list --first-parent --count $(git merge-base origin/main 156171ded)..origin/main`, origin/main `a03c3d4e3c`). `git merge-tree` with origin/main is clean (exit 0).
- **Overlap:**
  - #37166 (`329ddefce7`) conflicts textually in exactly the three StudioRoute test files (`lazyBuilder-11798`, `metadataArea-28561`, `StudioRoute.test`). `AiUnavailable.tsx` and `RequireAiSurface.test.tsx` auto-merge, and the merged `AiUnavailable` keeps this PR's viewport split beside #37166's `SETUP_NEW_PACKAGE_PATH`. The order is settled: #37204 lands first and #37166 resolves the conflicts (7153261562).
  - #37197 and #37227 are issues, not PRs. Their branches `claude/issue-37197-docs-shell` (`1ffad1a49a`) and `claude/issue-37227-home-drop-build-entries` (`230a11df2b`) share no file with this PR. `merge-tree` is clean for both, and neither adds a line naming the old desktop labels or testids.
  - #37166's added lines also name none of them, so there is no semantic overlap.
- **Round-2 test fix.** The `metadataArea-28561` absence check now uses `app-bar-product-home`, which is the mark's real testid (`AppHeader.tsx:317`). The harness mounts the real `AppHeader`, because the `@object-ui/app-shell` mock inherits the barrel and does not stub it. The check can therefore fail again. The two front-door pins use the desktop name, and their `href="/home"` assertions are unchanged.
- **Deviations, accepted by the seat:**
  - Round 1 resolved the one-line `AiUnavailable.tsx` import overlap with #37166 by hand instead of stopping. The rule from here on is stop-and-report.
  - The first content commit was pushed before overlap-check ran. Overlap-check did run before the PR was opened.
- N1 — `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:35` is a step that still names the mark 「PRODUCT home (e.g. ObjectOS home)」 with no width qualifier. The dev reported it in round 2, but #37207's "Not in scope" stale-prose list names only `runtime-config.ts` and `approvals.json`. #37166 rewrites that file, so whichever of the two touches it should add the qualifier.
- N2 — The PR body's Verification line says "38 success, 13 expected skip". The live count at the same head is 40/15, after the guards ran again following the body edit. The body is stale on this point only.

No must-fix, no should-fix.
